text:
Maya: quick UX check on Keys & Retention panel 1 - spotted a few readability and layout nits. can we look?
Liam: sure, drop screenshots or notes here.
Maya: biggest issues: long key labels are wrapping and pushing the toggle offscreen on narrow panes; audit log lines dump full ARNs inline; region picker is visually distant from the encrypt toggle so users miss the association.
Aisha: yep saw that. current primary label is basically the full arn -> `arn:aws:kms:...`. noisy.
Maya: my suggestion for the visible label: `Managed key (BYOK)` as the single-line headline, with a muted `key-0a1b2c...` beneath only when expanded. reduces clutter.
Liam: that short headline should help scanning and also reduce line wraps on tablet.
Aisha: audit log example today: `2026-04-01 14:03:22 - key set: arn:aws:kms:... user=alice` 1 unreadable. propose `14:03 UTC 1 1 1 - Key set by alice (key-0a1b)` w/ expand for full ARN + request id.
Maya: yes, and standardize tense to past (`set` / `rotated` / `accessed`) so timeline reads naturally.
Liam: accessibility: the encrypt toggle currently has aria-label that concatenates the full ARN; screen readers read the entire thing. change: aria-describedby -> point to the short headline element, keep full ARN only in the details region and expose via a `View key details` button.
Aisha: also request a small tooltip on hover: `View key details` and a copy icon beside the truncated id.
Maya: layout tweak for small widths: stack as `Region` > `Retention` > `Encryption` so the action toggle stays above the fold.
Liam: copy nit for retention CTA: `Set retention` is vague. prefer `Change retention period` (matches the edit flow).
Aisha: quick checklist to PR: 1) headline -> `Managed key (BYOK)` 2) show truncated id inline, full in expandable panel 3) timeline entries -> `HH:MM UTC 1 - <Event> by <actor> (key-xxxx)` with expand for details 4) reorder fields on narrow view 5) update aria-describedby for toggle 6) add hover tooltip + copy icon.
Maya: great. I'll update the Figma frames and small copy doc. Liam - can you flag @a11y for a quick review on the aria pattern?
Liam: pinging @a11y now. also filing INF-8201 to track (P3).
DevBot: automated note - issue INF-8201 created: "Compact key label + timeline readability".
Maya: thanks team 1.
_meta: Generated Slack-style thread for product design review about key labels, audit log copy, and narrow-layout accessibility nits.
